scope: bounded public fact composition; not universal mod accuracy, exact server configuration or effective datapack recipes
review_method: Read primary author descriptions and Git-pinned public README blobs; store original short factual paraphrases, not whole documents or commands.
Keep general author guidance separate from installed-version guarantees, live settings and exact exported base recipes.
Each fact references a public source. Technical dependency cards describe their role rather than inventing player controls.
Retrieve at most six same-topic facts. Native model may return only one or two available IDs; no arbitrary factual output is accepted.
Equivalent authored wording variants and bounded per-author voice provide variation without unqualified new factual claims.
limitations: Coverage includes all observed mod IDs, not every feature or question.
General primary pages can describe a newer version than the installed mod.
Exact claim rights, owners, limits and effective modpack recipe overrides are not inferred.
No private configurations, player records, source code commands or channel transcripts enter this pack.
A model-selection failure asks a focused clarification and does not loosen the policy.
